meta.title: Packet Tracer Topology Engine
meta.description: Read and write Cisco Packet Tracer .pkt files offline: build topologies, wire them precisely, inject IOS configuration, then open them in Packet Tracer.
meta.detail: The ptforge engine decrypts/re-encrypts the .pkt container (Twofish-EAX) locally, assembles devices and links from this machine's own PT templates, and writes RUNNINGCONFIG text that PT parses on load. Tools: pt_models, pt_build, pt_inspect, pt_apply, pt_open.
